answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 53640 Country: India Title: lease land to the bank Question: I own a property which is leased to the bank for a couple of years. Is the income received is halal or haram? Answer ID: 53640 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1157/939/H=08/1435) Though it is not good to give it but the rent cannot be termed as haram. You may spend this rent on you and your families. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
